SYNTHETIC_REFLECTIONS.situation: During a long-term engineering project, the team repeatedly encountered systemic coordination and decision-making problems despite strong individual effort. The reflection focused on impact of engineering on society.
SYNTHETIC_REFLECTIONS.task_action: I introduced feedback loops, structured reflection sessions, and shared system-level tracking so the team could identify issues before they escalated.
SYNTHETIC_REFLECTIONS.result: The project became significantly more proactive and adaptive because issues were identified and addressed earlier in the workflow.
